quality.content:
1. Adding zero to any number leaves the value unchanged.
2. Multiplying any number by one results in the same number.
3. The sum of two even numbers is always even.
4. Dividing a number by itself equals one.
5. Negative times negative yields a positive product.
6. The square root of sixteen is four.
7. Zero is considered an even number.
8. Prime numbers have exactly two distinct divisors.
9. The number one is not a prime number.
10. Two is the only even prime number.
11. The Fibonacci sequence starts with zero and one.
12. Each Fibonacci number is the sum of the previous two.
13. Pi is an irrational number.
14. Pi cannot be expressed as a simple fraction.
15. The value of pi is approximately 3.14159.
16. Euler's number e is approximately 2.71828.
17. e is the base of the natural logarithm.
18. The logarithm of one is zero.
19. The logarithm of ten to the power of n is n.
20. A perfect square is an integer squared.
21. Four is the smallest perfect square greater than one.
22. The sum of angles in a triangle is 180 degrees.
23. A right triangle has one 90-degree angle.
24. The Pythagorean theorem applies to right triangles.
25. The hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle.
26. The area of a circle is pi times radius squared.
27. The circumference of a circle is two pi times radius.
28. A square has four equal sides.
29. A rectangle has opposite sides that are equal.
30. A rhombus has all sides of equal length.
31. A parallelogram has opposite sides that are parallel.
32. The volume of a cube is side length cubed.
33. The surface area of a sphere is four pi r squared.
34. The volume of a sphere is four-thirds pi r cubed.
35. A cylinder has two circular bases.
36. A cone has a circular base and a point.
37. A prism has two identical polygonal bases.
